dialogues.speaker: Lalli
dialogues.text: No, no, no. If you replace the head with a machine, then it's no longer human...

dialogues.speaker: Bozena
dialogues.text: It's still got a human body! But if you replace everything from the neck down, like you say, then it's definitely not a human!

dialogues.speaker: Lalli
dialogues.text: If you replace the head with a machine, it'll make a "Buzz, buzz" sound when it speaks, and a "Clank, clank" sound when it walks. Does that sound like a human to you?

dialogues.speaker: Bozena
dialogues.text: But if you replace everything below the head with a machine, it'll still make a "Clank, clank" sound when it walks!

dialogues.speaker: Lalli
dialogues.text: Th—That's an entirely different type of "Clank, clank" sound! Besides... if you only replace the body, then it can still talk like a human!

dialogues.speaker: Bozena
dialogues.text: The voice isn't important! What's important is that it still says what it's supposed to!

dialogues.speaker: Lalli
dialogues.text: Hoho! You've got no comeback for that, do you...
